info.description: Backend API for e-journal, attendance links and invite registration.
info.title: EJournal Backend API

post.description: Generates a password reset token and sends it to the user's email.
Resets user password using the provided reset token.

get.description: Returns groups, teachers and students scoped to the caller's role: teacher -> own groups, head -> own lectern, dean -> own faculty, admin -> everything.

post.description: Student confirms attendance for active session.

get.description: Returns attendance marks grouped by date for current student and selected year.

post.description: Student gets own grade sheet for a subject.
post.summary: Get current student grades by subject

get.description: Returns every plan subject with its grade items and per-subject totals, plus an aggregate summary, in one request.
get.summary: Get all grades for the current student

post.description: Student marks attendance with lesson ID, device ID, and current location.

get.description: Returns one point per subject (from the student's group schedule) with the score/percent the student earned on graded-so-far work this semester.
Returns the current student's lessons for a given date, restricted to the current or next calendar week. Defaults to today if date is omitted.
get.summary: Get student's schedule for a day

parameters.description: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)
parameters.name: date

post.description: Teacher creates attendance session and gets invite/join URL. If subject_id/group_ids are omitted, they are taken from nearest scheduled lesson.
Returns per-student attendance stats for selected group and optional subject.
Teacher sets a student's attendance status (present/absent/late/excused) for a session they own, overriding self/device check-in.
post.summary: Manually correct a student's attendance status

post.description: Teacher creates attendance session and gets invite/join URL. If subject_id/group_ids are omitted, they are taken from nearest scheduled lesson.

get.description: Returns current teacher attendance session that has not expired yet.
Returns how many students have marked attendance in a teacher-owned session.
Returns remaining seconds for a teacher-owned attendance session.

post.description: Teacher gets the detailed attendance history of a specific student for a specific subject.
post.summary: Get a student's attendance history for a subject

post.description: Teacher creates or updates a student's score for a grade item.
Teacher creates a subject grade item/control point.
Teacher lists grade items/control points for assigned subject.
Teacher gets a student's grade sheet for an assigned subject.
Teacher gets a combined per-student overview (attendance and grade totals) for a group on a subject.
post.summary: Get a group performance overview for a subject

post.description: Teacher gets the per-subject performance radar for a student they teach.

get.description: Returns subjects (and groups) assigned to current teacher from schedule.

post.description: Links/updates email for current user.
Saves a JPEG, PNG, or WebP profile picture up to 5 MiB and returns its public URL.
Teacher creates an attendance lesson using subject/group names or IDs and current location.
Authenticates a user and returns JWT token.

get.description: Returns current user profile from Authorization token.

post.description: Registers a user by one-time invite_code. Legacy role_hash registration remains supported for existing clients.
Creates student, teacher, or admin account by one-time invite code from database.
